title: A pesar de que + subjuntivo: una contradicción reconocida

sections.content: A pesar de que (despite the fact that) works much like aunque, and takes the subjunctive under the same condition -- when the writer is granting a point rather than reporting settled fact, useful for naming a contradiction the text wants to hold in view rather than resolve. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: A pesar de que la construcción de un Estado más fuerte podría parecer un asunto puramente administrativo, estuvo acompañada por un ambicioso proyecto cultural.
items.english: Despite the fact that building a stronger state might seem a purely administrative matter, it was accompanied by an ambitious cultural project.

items.spanish: El indigenismo buscaba incorporar el pasado prehispánico a la identidad nacional, a pesar de que las comunidades indígenas vivas siguieran sufriendo pobreza extrema.
items.english: Indigenismo sought to incorporate the pre-Hispanic past into national identity, despite the fact that living indigenous communities kept suffering extreme poverty.

items.spanish: La Semana de Arte Moderno buscó, a pesar de las resistencias de los sectores más conservadores, definir una identidad artística genuinamente brasileña.
items.english: Modern Art Week sought, despite resistance from the more conservative sectors, to define a genuinely Brazilian artistic identity.

items.spanish: Esta paradoja -celebrar el pasado indígena a pesar de que se ignoraran las condiciones reales de los pueblos indígenas contemporáneos- resultaría cada vez más visible.
items.english: This paradox -- officially celebrating the indigenous past despite the real conditions of contemporary indigenous peoples being ignored -- would become increasingly visible.

sections.content: A pesar de (without que) works directly before a noun -- a pesar de las resistencias -- while a pesar de que introduces a full clause with its own conjugated verb, exactly like the debido a / debido a que pair you learned earlier.
